region: United States, USD. Rates differ in other countries.
note: Online card rates when you use Shopify Payments. If you use another payment provider, Shopify adds its third-party transaction fee on top of that provider's own rate. Monthly prices are what Shopify lists when you pay monthly; paying yearly lists lower prices.
paypalWallet: Starting at 3.49% + 49 cents (Shopify lists the same starting rate on every plan).
trial: Shopify lists a free 3-day trial, then $1 a month for 3 months on most plans. Check the pricing page before you count on it.
